Revocation of Syria Sanctions; Publication of Syria Frequently Asked Questions; Syria and Syria-related Designation Updates and Removals
Release Date
06/30/2025
Press Release Link
Treasury Implements President's Termination of Syria Sanctions
Ending the Syria Sanctions Program for the Benefit of the Syrian People
Recent Actions Body
PLEASE NOTE: OFAC
amended this notice
on August 4, 2025.
On June 30, the President issued an
Executive Order "Providing for the Revocation of Syria Sanctions"
that removes U.S. sanctions on Syria, effective July 1, 2025. To implement the President's action, the U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) has issued four new Syria Frequently Asked Questions (
FAQs 1220-1223
).
OFAC previously issued
Syria General License (GL) 25
, which authorizes transactions otherwise prohibited by the Syrian Sanctions Regulations, 31 CFR part 542. To the extent still necessary, persons may continue to rely on GL 25 and the related
Syria GL 25 Fact Sheet
, which OFAC originally issued on May 28, 2025.
Accordingly, the OFAC Syria-related sanctions program has become the
Promoting Accountability for Assad and Regional Stabilization Sanctions (PAARSS) program
.
This has resulted in the following updates and removals to OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) and Sectoral Sanctions Identifications List (SSI List).
